## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; domain coverage stays ≥ 85 %.
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, guide or ADR) if behaviour changed.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the dependency is justified and license-checked.
- [ ] Security reviewed: policy, jail, approvals, secrets, network.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`Signed-off-by`).
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or golden file.
